pros.text: Free cash flow yield 14.9%: setiap $100 nilai saham menghasilkan $14.9 kas bebas per tahun ($3.9 M).
P/E forward 9.2x — 51% lebih murah dari median sektor Teknologi (18.7x).
Estimasi nilai wajar $46.34 vs harga $28.88 — potensi naik 60% (rentang $23–$54).
ROIC 35% — bisnis menghasilkan imbal hasil sangat tinggi atas setiap dolar modal yang ditanam (lebih baik dari 88% emiten Teknologi).
PEG ratio 0.45 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 20% — dari $2.62 ke $3.15.

summary: HP Inc. provides personal computing, printing, 3D printing, hybrid work, gaming, and other related technologies in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Personal Systems, Printing, and Corporate Investments. The Personal Systems segment offers commercial and consumer desktops and notebooks, workstations, thin clients, retail point-of-sale systems, displays, software, hybrid systems, and endpoint security and services, as well as lifecycle services, including support and deployment, configurations, and extended warranty services. thesis: HP Inc. memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 51/100) dengan keunggulan utama di valuasi (93) dan kualitas bisnis (47). Titik lemahnya ada di pertumbuhan (26). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $46.34 — potensi naik 60.5% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan sedang). Kondisi teknikal kuat (77/100). Risiko geopolitik sangat tinggi, terutama dari tema Kontrol Ekspor Chip & Selat Taiwan; berpeluang diuntungkan tema Perang Siber.
